fed.note: FOMC held the target range steady; dissenters Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack both wanted a 25bp hike. Chair Warsh called inflation "elevated" and said the Fed will cut the number of rate-setting meetings starting 2027. No new decision since (next meeting 9-10 Dec). No FOMC meeting fell in the last 7 days, so this block is carried forward unchanged. The 10Y eased to 4.92% on 20 Nov from 5.04% on 19 Nov, extending the pullback from the 5.15% high on 13 Nov.

catalysts.name: Palo Alto Networks, Inc.
catalysts.what: Palo Alto Networks reported fiscal Q1 2027 results on 18 Nov: non-GAAP EPS $1.05 vs about $0.97 consensus, revenue $3.445B vs $3.31B expected (+39.2% y/y), Next-Gen Security ARR +66% to $9.73B. The company raised FY2027 guidance - revenue to $14.52-$14.57B (from $14.10-$14.20B) and non-GAAP EPS to $4.26-$4.30 (from $4.16-$4.19) - and announced a $4.5B all-stock deal for Applied Compute. Shares are up 2.9% today to $353.43, extending the recovery from the post-earnings pullback as the broad market rallied hard (S&P +4.7%).

catalysts.name: Target Corporation
catalysts.what: Target reported fiscal Q3 2026 results on 18 Nov: adjusted EPS $2.65 vs $2.07 consensus (helped by about $0.50/share of one-time tariff-refund benefits; ex-refund EPS was still roughly $2.15, above the $2.07 Street number), revenue $27.07B vs $26.38B expected (+2.6%). The company raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $10.65-$11.40 and lifted net-sales-growth guidance to about 6%. Shares are up 1.4% today to $168.20, participating in the broad market rally (S&P +4.7%).

catalysts.name: Medtronic Plc
catalysts.what: Piper Sandler analyst Matt O'Brien upgraded Medtronic to Overweight from Neutral and raised the price target to $120 from $85 on 17 Nov, about 19% above today's $100.72 price (16.6% above the $102.88 price when the call was made) - citing cardiac-ablation and renal-denervation growth driving revenue above Street estimates through 2030, ahead of Medtronic's 11 Dec investor meeting. Shares are up 0.8% today to $100.72, a muted move in a broadly strong session (S&P +4.7%).

PANW.what: Cybersecurity platform provider offering next-generation firewalls, cloud security (Prisma) and AI-driven threat detection (Cortex) for enterprises and government agencies worldwide.

TGT.what: Large-format general merchandise and grocery retailer operating roughly 1,980 Target stores plus digital and same-day fulfillment across the US.

MDT.what: Global medical-device maker selling cardiac, surgical, neuroscience and diabetes-management therapies including pacemakers, defibrillators, surgical robotics and insulin pumps.
